entities.summary: St. Nicholas Monastery Complex is an active women's Orthodox monastery of the Belarusian Exarchate in Mogilev. The ensemble includes St. Nicholas Cathedral and Church of St Onuphrius, it is a monument of Baroque architecture in Belarus. Nicholas Monastery Complex, Mahilioŭ is a monastery in Europe.
